items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Dave Capp was the A and R man; he was sort of stuck with it at this point... Dave had to fight for it.

ctx.x: They just assumed that because you had written for Goodman and Bill had written for Miller that that's what they were going to get?

So we came in and did "Doodletown Fifers" and a couple of other things, about four things we had to do the first session and Dave Capp was the A and R man; he was sort of stuck with it at this point. The sales department didn't want any part of that and Dave had to fight for it.
